title: Integrated AlphaHoldem recipe 262k multi-seed scale
benchmark: A frozen learned policy plays at least 100,000 fresh 200bb HUNL Slumbot hands, scores above 0 bb/100, and has a 95% confidence-interval lower bound above 0.
hypothesis: The reproducible positive approximately20k-to-70k learned-policy slopes will continue from approximately70k to 262,144 actual environment hands in at least two of three independent lineages, without proxy reversal, seat collapse, source-policy catastrophe, or resume-state discontinuity.
material_change: Resume the exact three 70k checkpoints with unchanged optimizer, serialized two-iteration replay, dynamic loss-K-best pool, adaptive league state, total/iteration counters, and assignment RNG evidence. Continue each to 262,144 cumulative actual hands. Copy prior metrics/assignment evidence into new immutable phase directories, keep the same lineage run ids and seeds, and use later nonoverlapping windows of the same fixed per-worker deal streams.
baseline: The parent geometric pilot produced three positive frozen final-minus-iter4 slopes (+5.87,+3.94,+5.75 bb/100), seed-level t95 [+2.51,+7.87], 10/12 positive anchor cells, both seats positive in all seeds, and 3/3 Standard10 preservation passes after 209,408 actual hands.

notes: Resume gate requires exact optimizer/replay/pool/adaptive-state/accounting serialization and replayable assignment evidence. New deal starts 13.1M/14.1M/15.1M are beyond each worker's first unused upper bound, so no prior deal can repeat; deterministic gaps are allowed and recorded.

Promotion requires at least two of three positive 70k-to-262k pooled slopes on a fresh untouched common-deal panel, positive median slope, at least two seeds with both pooled seats nonnegative and at least three of four anchor slopes nonnegative, all source-preservation gates pass, and no mechanism/accounting failure. Negative absolute Slumbot at this scale is not a rejection criterion; no Slumbot is planned.

Resume preflight passed for all three seeds. Staged metric and assignment files are byte-identical copies of their immutable parent evidence; source checkpoints remain in the completed parent experiment and are read-only inputs.

Attempt1 stopped before its first PPO update with zero new environment hands when startup exposed train_v5's reset_optimizer=True default. It wrote an initial checkpoint with reset Adam and one iteration16 assignment row, both quarantined in seed1/ and never used. Retry is restaged byte-exactly from the immutable parent and explicitly uses --no-reset-optimizer --preserve-resumed-optimizer-lr.

Seed1 valid retry completed at cumulative actual environment hands=263,423, inherited=69,802, new=193,621; transition hands=230,710, iteration=56. No replay recovery boundary or optimizer reset occurred.
Seed2 completed at cumulative actual environment hands=263,905, inherited=69,608, new=194,297; transition hands=226,670, iteration=55. Optimizer/replay/assignment state remained continuous.

Scale audit generalized for continuation lineages: validates parent checkpoint SHA, preserved optimizer flags, exact environment/transition/replay accounting, suffix-only train log, configurable 262,144-hand gate, and iteration 16/32/48 archives. Seed1 and Seed2 independently pass every gate; this corrects the per-process legacy rebind flag by verifying the already-rebound immutable parent contract.

Seed3 completed naturally at cumulative actual environment hands=265,036, inherited=69,998, new=195,038; transition hands=230,650, iteration=56. Optimizer/replay/assignment state remained continuous; no replay recovery or KL stop occurred.

result.summary: Three exact-state continuations reached 263,423, 263,905, and 265,036 cumulative actual environment hands (792,364 total); all 22 artifact/continuation gates per seed passed. Fresh 70k-to-262k frozen slopes were +1.221, +2.271, and -4.402 bb/100 over 98,304 evaluation hands; every Standard10 drift audit passed.
result.conclusion: The integrated AlphaHoldem recipe remains stable and source-preserving, and two of three lineages retained positive pooled slopes, but the multi-seed breadth evidence did not reproduce: only Seed1 had at least three positive anchors and both seats positive; Seed3 reversed on both seats. This is insufficient-training-or-objective-variance evidence, not catastrophic-mechanism rejection, but it fails the preregistered 1M promotion gate.
result.next_step: Use the existing raw common-deck rows to localize the anchor, seat, street/action, and cross-scale source of variance. Admit at most one deeper convergence control only if the audit identifies a coherent, reproducible signal; otherwise change the opponent-league or optimization objective before spending 1M hands.
